notes: All usable candidates show the palace and park, not the town. #1’s maker isn’t named in the truncated record (the neighboring plate #2 is signed Perelle). #14 is only 1024 px wide, so the card will be soft. #15 is weak (a garden vase fills the left half); drop it if a blank plate is preferred. Rejected: #3 (old château, dated only 1654–1711), #4 (optical print dated only 1700–99), #7 (Vollon drawing, undated), #19 and #20 (museum snapshots of a Rigaud print behind glass, print date not given), the photochrom interiors #9–#12 and the Grand Trianon #13, the chapel interior #17, the Orpen 1919 treaty painting #16, paintings of other places held in the palace museum (#5 Lodi, #6 Port Mahon), the 1745 ball interior #8, and #18 (a house named Versailles in Virginia).
